title: Third order Einstein deformations for Kaehler-Einstein metrics
summary: For compact Kähler manifolds $(M,g,J)$ with negative scalar curvature we study the existence problem for non-trivial Einstein deformations of $g$, that is small time curves $g_t$ of Einstein metrics with $g_0=g$. No asssumption on the complex structure $J$ is made; also we do not assume that the metrics $g_t$ are Kähler w.r.t. $J$. We determine explicitly the obstruction to third order Einstein deformation for $g$; that is we fully solve the equations $(\Ric^{g_t})^{(k)}(0)=0$ for $1 \leq k \le 3$ in terms of the Taylor expansion…
